title: State inspection blocked for five months, then hasty return home
summary: Jordan tells of State inspection blocked for five months, then hasty return home, about 2010 at Baker Victory Services / Springville, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Baker Victory Services / Springville, New York

tellings.quote: apparently for 5 months, the record something goes, uh, Baker Victory Services was refusing access to the state to come in and inspect me,

plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a UFO-related government program as a child, tells a podcast host about records from around 2010 at Baker Victory Services, an organization in Springville, New York, where he was staying. Jordan says that, according to the records, the place refused to let state officials in to inspect his situation for five months, and that he was then sent home in a hurry. He mentions a man named Ross Colart in telling it, and to him it points to something being hidden.
